cohort: Teenage pregnant women (10-19 years old) who delivered in a tertiary care hospital in Karwar, India over a one-year period (n=41).
finding: Teenage pregnancy is associated with a significantly higher risk of preterm labor and neonatal morbidities.
mod_finding: Among the teen mothers, 63% delivered vaginally and 35% underwent LSCS.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 14% of the neonates born to teenage mothers.
